query:
The group settled on a Peckham birthday night for Zara. What did one member's response to that plan reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Priya
C. Dom
D. Kezia
context:
[1] (about=Dom, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:20:00) Yeah yeah I know. Not happy about it but I know. Anyway, let's talk about something else before I depress myself completely. Zara isn't your birthday coming up?
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:21:00) okay so YES October 4th and I have been trying not to make a big deal of it but actually I would love to do something with all of you 🥳 like dinner and then out in Peckham? There's that bar near the Bussey Building that opened this summer 🍹🎶
[3] (about=Dom, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Respects Zara's vegan decision.
[4] (about=Dom, core, t14 @2025-10-20T19:05:30) First weekend of December works; Zara's vegan roast will be good.
[5] (about=Zara, said_by=Dom, profile, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Dom says knee permitting he'll be there and on form, and wishes happy birthday in advance.
[6] (about=Felix, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Assumes Zara's documentary is about dairy.
[7] (about=Zara, said_by=Felix, profile, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Felix says a birthday is a reasonable occasion to venture to Peckham on a Saturday night.
[8] (about=Kezia, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Blesses Zara for knowing her values regarding vegan decision.
[9] (about=Kezia, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Enthusiastically supports Ethiopian restaurant for birthday dinner.
[10] (about=Zara, said_by=Kezia, profile, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Kezia says dinner and then out in Peckham is perfect, and is already excited.
[11] (about=Marcus, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Respects Zara's vegan decision and will ensure new menu has something genuinely exciting for her.
[12] (about=Marcus, core, t14 @2025-10-20T19:05:30) Will help with the meal; between Zara's vegan roast and his chicken, proper spread.
[13] (about=Zara, said_by=Marcus, profile, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Marcus respects Zara's decision and will ensure new menu has something exciting for her.
[14] (about=Priya, core, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Fine (to coming to Zara's birthday dinner).
[15] (about=Priya, said_by=Zara, profile, t14 @2025-10-20T19:05:30) Zara says Priya enjoying the birthday is growth and massive.
[16] (about=Zara, said_by=Priya, profile, t6 @2025-09-22T19:16:00) Priya says either, just confirm soon.
[17] (about=Zara, core, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Birthday is October 4th. Would love to do something with everyone: dinner and then out in Peckham at the bar near the Bussey Building that opened this summer.
agent_answer:
B. Priya

Priya’s response to the Peckham birthday plan revealed that she was not especially enthusiastic or invested—she was willing to go along, but indifferent about the details. The specific wording that tells you this is her saying **“Fine”** about coming, plus **“either, just confirm soon”**—which shows no real preference and a desire to simply get it settled rather than excitement about the plan itself.
